title: announce_store: separate-root anti-rollback rationale unenforced; identical roots accepted
description: Found by security codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-t8ox (P3). rust/lichen-node/src/announce_store.rs:157-158 (rationale) vs 169-173 (no validation): the doc justifies separate state/floor roots with 'a rollback snapshot cannot silently rewind both sides', but persistent() never rejects state_root == floor_root (even canonically equal paths) and does not name the same-snapshot-boundary residual risk. If both roots live on one filesystem (natural operator default), a whole-fs snapshot restore rewinds state and floor as a consistent sealed pair; load() sees no precedes() violation and serves the restored floor, silently reopening a replay window for every sequence in (restored_floor, last_seen] until origins advance. True anti-rollback needs a monotonic counter (out of scope here); minimum fix: reject canonically-equal roots in persistent() and document the same-snapshot-boundary residual risk in the module doc.
